name: omega-wallet-desktop
description: Tauri v2 wrapper packaging the synced Omega wallet GUI as native installers.

scripts.build:linux: npm run sync:wallet && tauri build --target-dir target --bundles appimage,deb
scripts.build:macos: npm run sync:wallet && tauri build --target-dir target --bundles dmg
scripts.build:windows: npm run sync:wallet && tauri build --target-dir target --bundles msi
